notes: Route master covers the corridors requested by the project owner.
Only station sequences with source-supported details are populated in this starter file.
A route's stationKm is measured from that route's declared origin; it is not necessarily the official fare distance.
Fare rules are intentionally empty until current official suburban fare tables are verified.
Do not calculate or sell real tickets using illustrative or incomplete data.
metadata.importantWarning: This is a consolidated development database, not a certified complete fare dataset. Several requested corridors still need verified station sequences, exact station codes and official fare distances. Do not sell tickets or quote official fares from unverified fields.
sources: Eastern Railway Combined Suburban Time Table 2019-2020 (official; historical timetable)
Eastern line (Kolkata Suburban Railway) station tables (secondary source)
South Eastern line (Kolkata Suburban Railway) station tables (secondary source)

fareRules.calculationPolicy: Use official fare distance and effective fare slab, not straight-line distance or an invented per-km rate.

dataQuality.routeCoverage: Some routes populated; remaining route station sequences intentionally left empty pending verification.
dataQuality.stationKmMeaning: Cumulative route distance shown in source material. It may differ from official fare distance.
dataQuality.nullStationCodeMeaning: Station code not reliably established in source used.
dataQuality.nullStationKmMeaning: A dependable cumulative kilometre value was not established; do not interpolate for fares.
